/* VIRTUS / EXTRA CHARACTER MOTION -- v2 */
.virt-us{color:#fcbde2;text-shadow:0 0 10px #6fd7ff88}.virtus-splash{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 60%,#171727 0,#080a11 48%,#020307 88%);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;color:#e7e3ed}
.virtus-ambient{position:absolute;inset:-35%;background:conic-gradient(from 20deg at 60% 52%,transparent 10%,#103c441c 16%,transparent 21%,#521b762d 43%,transparent 51%,#09593526 76%,transparent 85%);filter:blur(55px);animation:virtDrift 17s linear infinite}
.virtus-stars{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.26;background-image:radial-gradient(white 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:87px 93px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse,white,transparent 80%)}
.virtus-brand-wrap{position:relative;z-index:4;width:min(94vw,930px);opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px) scale(.98);text-align:center;filter:brightness(.56)}
.virtus-mark{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:2/1;object-fit:contain;position:relative;z-index:3;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 22px #000c)}
.virtus-brand-wrap p{position:relative;z-index:3;color:#b2a4bc;font:500 clamp(10px,1.5vw,15px)/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.47em;margin:-3px 0 0}
.virtus-aura{position:absolute;z-index:1;width:48%;height:98%;left:49%;top:0;opacity:0;filter:blur(27px);border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 3deg,#109ee800,#39b7ffb8 50deg,#ee4ab588 108deg,#27094200 160deg,#43d3ab88 230deg,#8a49cd88 295deg,#3497e4a3 341deg,#109ee800);mix-blend-mode:screen}
.virtus-glance{position:absolute;z-index:5;width:9%;height:60%;top:17%;left:45%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#d4e7fa28,#fff9f9aa,#d4e7fa28,transparent);filter:blur(14px);transform:skewX(-20deg);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.virtus-intro-actions{position:absolute;z-index:20;bottom:12%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px}.intro-sound,.intro-skip{border:1px solid #aeacc172;border-radius:4px;padding:13px 19px;background:#080a12d8;color:#f6f4ff;font:600 10px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.19em}.intro-skip{background:transparent;color:#adb3c9;border-color:transparent}.virtus-signature{position:absolute;z-index:6;bottom:4%;color:#7c7e8f;font:10px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.32em;text-align:center}
.virtus-curtain{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#020307;z-index:10;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.virtus-splash.playing .virtus-brand-wrap{animation:virtReveal 6.65s ease both}.virtus-splash.playing .virtus-aura{animation:virtAura 6.65s ease-in-out both,virtDrift 17s linear infinite}.virtus-splash.playing .virtus-glance{animation:virtGlance 6.65s ease-in-out both}.virtus-splash.playing .virtus-curtain{animation:virtFadeOut 6.65s ease-in both}
.virtus-splash.finished{transition:opacity .4s;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes virtDrift{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes virtReveal{0%,8%{opacity:0;filter:brightness(.25) blur(3px);transform:scale(.975)}25%{opacity:1;filter:brightness(.7)}45%,73%{opacity:1;filter:brightness(1);transform:scale(1)}89%{opacity:.8}100%{opacity:0;filter:brightness(.4)}}@keyframes virtAura{0%,14%{opacity:0}38%{opacity:.3}55%{opacity:.5}70%{opacity:.35}96%,100%{opacity:0}}@keyframes virtGlance{0%,28%{opacity:0;left:44%}48%{opacity:.07}55%{opacity:.8;left:75%}70%,100%{opacity:0;left:94%}}@keyframes virtFadeOut{0%,82%{opacity:0}100%{opacity:1}}
.virtus-splash .intro-sound,.virtus-splash .intro-skip{transition:filter .15s}.intro-sound:active,.intro-skip:active{filter:brightness(1.7)}
.character-zone{transition:right .3s,width .3s;transform-origin:bottom center}
.character-art{transition:filter .25s,object-position .25s;animation:spriteBreath 4.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.character-art.outfit-art{object-position:center 42%;border-color:#89c3ffe6;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #04051cdd,0 0 46px #39b6d144}
.character-art.portrait-art{border-color:#f1bddb88}
.character-art.stance-0{transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.character-art.stance-1{transform:rotate(2.2deg) translateY(-2px)}
.character-art.stance-2{transform:rotate(-1deg) translateX(5px);filter:saturate(1.14)}
.character-art.stance-3{transform:rotate(1.5deg) translateY(4px);filter:contrast(1.03)}
.pose-spark{position:absolute;left:-22px;top:20%;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 15px #62dfff;background:#80e4ff99;animation:poseSpark 3.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes spriteBreath{from{scale:1;translate:0 0}to{scale:1.015;translate:0 -7px}}@keyframes poseSpark{to{top:33%;opacity:.15}}
@media(max-width:760px){.virtus-brand-wrap{width:100vw}.virtus-brand-wrap p{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.21em;margin-top:-10px}.virtus-intro-actions{bottom:14%}.virtus-signature{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em}.character-art.outfit-art{object-position:center 30%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.character-art,.virtus-ambient,.pose-spark{animation:none!important}}

/* Botón de efectos de sonido accesible antes del juego */
.title-sound-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:fit-content;max-width:100%;margin:13px 0 0;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #b5cbfc77;background:#0c183b8c;color:#e7e5fa;font:600 11px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #07091a88}.title-sound-btn:hover{background:#203864ad}.title-sound-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff7db2}.game-actions #soundBtn[aria-pressed="false"]{opacity:.6}

/* ANEXADO EN EL AMOR · V4 · full-body, no-crop editorial sprites */
.title-screen{isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 63% 27%,#263e5c 0%,#10172d 48%,#080e1e 90%)}
.title-screen .title-wall{background-image:url("data:image/webp;base64,")!important;background-position:center!important;background-size:cover!important;filter:blur(5px) brightness(.56) saturate(.9)!important;transform:scale(1.055)}
.title-screen .title-wash{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#071022e9 0%,#091c32ad 52%,#091020ba 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,#081024e9 0%,transparent 52%,#07102255 100%)!important}
.title-stars{position:absolute;z-index:0;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 24%,#ff67a644 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 75% 28%,#81cbfa66 0 3px,transparent 4px),radial-gradient(circle at 72% 69%,#ff98bd77 0 2px,transparent 3px)}
.title-top,.title-content,.title-footer{position:relative;z-index:2}
.title-content{margin-top:clamp(12vh,14vh,130px);margin-bottom:clamp(4vh,6vh,70px);width:min(680px,90vw)}
.new-title-logo{display:block;width:min(720px,90vw);max-height:39vh;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 18px #000a);animation:logoRise .75s both}
.title-episode{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.28em;color:#d5d2e7;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 14px 2px}
.title-content .pitch{max-width:560px;margin-top:9px;color:#e6e7f6;line-height:1.64}
.title-profiles{display:none!important}
.title-screen .title-actions{margin-top:25px}
.game-screen{overflow:hidden}
.character-zone{left:auto!important;right:5%!important;top:93px!important;bottom:clamp(205px,27vh,290px)!important;width:min(47vw,490px)!important;height:auto!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;pointer-events:none;z-index:4!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 16px #020616d0)}
.actor-button{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;flex:1;width:100%;min-height:0;max-height:100%;padding:0;border:0;outline-offset:-10px;background:none;pointer-events:auto;cursor:zoom-in;overflow:visible}
.character-art,.character-art.outfit-art,.character-art.portrait-art{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;min-height:0;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center bottom!important;background:none!important;border:none!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 15px #071020cb);scale:1;translate:0 0;transform-origin:center bottom;animation:actorBreath 3.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;user-select:none}
.character-art.stance-0{transform:rotate(-1.4deg) translateX(-3%)}
.character-art.stance-1{transform:rotate(1deg) translateY(-1%)}
.character-art.stance-2{transform:rotate(-1deg) translateX(2%)}
.character-art.stance-3{transform:rotate(.8deg) translateY(-1%)}
.character-art.stance-4{transform:rotate(1.6deg) translateX(-1%)}
.sprite-halo{inset:16% 0 0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#ff479a32,transparent 65%);filter:blur(26px)}
.actor-tip{font:700 9px system-ui;letter-spacing:.11em;background:#08132bad;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:30px;color:#dceaff;white-space:nowrap;position:absolute;bottom:4px;opacity:.75}
.character-zone.is-short .character-art{scale:.8;transform-origin:center bottom}
.character-zone.is-trippy .character-art{scale:.89}
.discovery-banner{position:absolute;top:153px;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-20px);z-index:15;padding:12px 19px;white-space:nowrap;max-width:94%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;border:1px solid #f8c9e8ad;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#182243ed,#ad286dcc);font:800 10px system-ui;letter-spacing:.17em;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s;color:white;box-shadow:0 12px 27px #0008}
.discovery-banner.visible{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.portrait-modal{z-index:65!important;inset:0;background:#040716f0!important;backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.portrait-panel{position:relative;width:min(550px,97vw);height:min(93dvh,940px);border:1px solid #7485b96e;border-radius:19px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:6px 15px 75px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,#284065,#0d1530 65%,#090e20 98%)}
.portrait-panel>img{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 18px #000b)}
.portrait-close{position:absolute;right:17px;top:14px;z-index:6;color:white;font-size:19px;line-height:1;padding:13px;border-radius:100%;background:#192144e0;border:1px solid #b1cce580}
.portrait-aura{position:absolute;inset:22% 0 0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#f1499850,transparent 60%);filter:blur(48px)}
.portrait-caption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:18px;text-align:center;z-index:3;display:grid;gap:4px}
.portrait-caption small{font:800 10px system-ui;color:#f39bbf;letter-spacing:.2em}
.portrait-caption strong{font:700 clamp(20px,3vw,32px) Georgia,serif}
.note-locked{font:italic 14px/1.6 Georgia,serif;color:#abbad8}
.padrino-img{object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center bottom!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;width:min(350px,100%)!important;transform:none!important}
.end-layout{z-index:2}
@keyframes actorBreath{from{translate:0 0}to{translate:0 -4px}}
@keyframes logoRise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .title-content{margin-top:23vh;margin-bottom:10vh;width:100%}
 .new-title-logo{width:100%;max-height:26vh;object-position:center center;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 12px #000c)}
 .title-episode{text-align:center;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;margin:0 0 14px}
 .title-content .pitch{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;text-align:center;margin:12px auto 0;max-width:360px}
 .title-screen .title-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;margin:17px 0 0;gap:10px}
 .title-screen .title-actions button{width:100%;min-height:47px}
 .title-sound-btn{display:flex;margin:10px auto}
 .title-content .eyebrow{font-size:9px;text-align:center}
 .title-caption{text-align:center;font-size:9px}
 .character-zone{top:99px!important;right:0!important;left:7%!important;bottom:clamp(209px,35vh,315px)!important;width:86vw!important;max-width:none!important;height:auto!important;z-index:2!important}
 .character-art{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center bottom!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 12px #040713c9)}
 .actor-tip{bottom:2px;font-size:8px;opacity:.6}
 .story-bottom{z-index:9}
 .scene-location{z-index:7}
 .discovery-banner{top:128px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em}
 .padrino-img{height:165px!important}
}
@media(max-width:390px) and (max-height:740px){.character-zone{top:86px!important;bottom:clamp(260px,40vh,320px)!important}.story-card{max-height:58vh;overflow-y:auto}.title-content{margin-top:17vh}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.character-art{animation:none!important}.new-title-logo{animation:none!important}}
/* Keep the discovery notification below faces, not over them. */
.discovery-banner{top:auto;bottom:clamp(218px,30vh,288px)}
@media(max-width:760px){.discovery-banner{top:auto;bottom:clamp(220px,34vh,300px);font-size:9px}.padrino-img{height:255px!important;width:min(250px,66vw)!important}}
</style></head>
